input_claims.claim: The IP approximately identifies geographic location; the image claims United States / San Francisco / Cloudflare.
The image claims TCP 22/80/443 are open and maps them to ssh/http/https.
The image claims WHOIS identifies Cloudflare and abuse@cloudflare.com.
The image claims vulnerability scanning can find weaknesses and shows a cloudflare server plus an /admin finding.
The image claims one IP can reveal domains, mail, technologies and even accounts.
The defender side claims firewall/IDS logs, behavior analysis, blocking and incident correlation can connect the IP to other events.

name: YADO RC8 Digital Causal Workspace v1
on:
  push:
    branches: [yado-rc8-digital-consciousness-v1]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  experiment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Reconstruct exact v35 package
        run: python runtime/reconstruct_rc8v35.py
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r runtime/yado_rc8_v35/requirements-github.txt pytest
      - name: Locked v35 unittest regression
        working-directory: runtime/yado_rc8_v35
        env:
          PYTHONWARNINGS: error::ResourceWarning
        run: python -m unittest discover -v
      - name: Archive regression
        working-directory: runtime/yado_rc8_v35
        run: python -m pytest -q test_yado_evolution_archive_runtime_v1.py test_yado_evolution_archive_integration_v1.py
      - name: Run YADO digital consciousness theory synthesis and causal experiment
        env:
          YADO_GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          YADO_GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: python runt

name: YADO RC8 functional consciousness A-B
on:
  push:
    branches: [yado-rc8-consciousness-ab]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  ab:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Reconstruct exact RC8 v35 package
        run: python runtime/reconstruct_rc8v35.py
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r runtime/yado_rc8_v35/requirements-github.txt pytest
      - name: Overlay functional-consciousness candidate and A-B harness
        run: |
          cp runtime/yado_functional_consciousness_runtime_v1.py runtime/yado_rc8_v35/
          cp runtime/yado_consciousness_ab_benchmark_v1.py runtime/yado_rc8_v35/
      - name: Verify exact v35 bootstrap before experiment
        working-directory: runtime/yado_rc8_v35
        run: python -c "import yado_bootstrap, json; print(json.dumps(yado_bootstrap.bootstrap_integrity(), sort_keys=True))"
      - name: Paired 10-task A-B run
        working-directory: runtime/yado_rc8_v35
        run: python yado_consciousness_ab_benchmark_v1.p
